notes: Polymer barrel: a pale blue-white drum with two steel hoops, a bung and an amber hazard label. Drops polymer 2. Frames are the piece turned [-12, -4, 4, 12] degrees, lit from the top-left each time; loop them pingpong (`wrap` = 1,2,3,4,1... ; `pingpong` = 1,2,3,4,3,2,...), the game may also rotate the node.
